title: The cafile, capath and cadefault parameters of urllib.request.urlopen have been removed
summary: Python 3.13 removed the cafile, capath and cadefault parameters of urllib.request.urlopen, so using it raises an error.
replacement: the context parameter with an ssl.SSLContext

constraints: Keep the behavior of the code unchanged; check the replacement's argument and return-value differences.

steps.title: Replace the usage
steps.instructions: Replace each reported use of the cafile, capath and cadefault parameters of urllib.request.urlopen with the context parameter with an ssl.SSLContext.

verification.purpose: Run the tests with deprecation warnings as errors when pytest is used.
